plainText:
The Rise of Darkrai (Japanese: ディアルガ パルキア ダークライ Dialga VS Palkia VS Darkrai) is the adaptation of the movie of the same name. It was adapted by 鷹岬 諒 Ryo Takamisaki.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Strange Happenings Around Town
The Astonishing Power of Darkrai!!
The Battle That Warped Space-Time!!
Clash of the Three Titanic Forces!!
A Resounding Prayer for Peace

==Differences between the movie and the manga==
 
Baron Alberto's role is expanded somewhat.
is Godey's grandson, whereas he was Godey's great-grandson in the movie.
Maury, Allegra, and have greatly reduced roles. 
and are with Tonio in his lab when he discovers that Palkia is within Alamos Town.
isn't using disguises while working as Baron Alberto's reporters.
In the movie, Tonio finds a photo of Alice's grandmother and gives it to her, whereas in the manga, Alice already had this photo with her.
In the manga, the old photo shows only a young Alicia, whereas in the movie, the old photo shows Alicia with Godey.
In addition, "Oración" was not recorded on the back of this photo, Alice already knew about the existence of this song and its name in the manga version.
Tonio does not tell Alice the truth that it was who saved her as a child, whereas he told her in the movie version.
The manga ends with 's words "I'll be challenge you again someday", when he and see the shadow of the surviving Darkrai.
